Here's your **RSI Dip Buy** strategy on BTCUSDT (1h), now drafted and backtesting.

**Current market context:** BTC is at **$73,565**, down ~6.9% recently. RSI(14) is at **23.2 — deep oversold**, which is exactly the kind of dip this strategy looks for. Support sits near **$72,998** and resistance near **$79,499** (visible on the chart below).

---

**How the strategy works:**
- **Entry (buy):** When the 14-period RSI crosses **above 30** — meaning the dip is losing steam and momentum is turning up from oversold territory.
- **Exit (sell):** When RSI crosses **above 70** — the recovery has pushed into overbought, time to take profit. Or earlier if a **3% stop loss** or **6% take profit** is hit first.
- **Position size:** 10% of your balance per trade.

The idea is simple: buy fear (oversold), sell greed (overbought).

**Backtest details (queued):**
- **~10,000 hourly candles** (roughly 14 months of data)
- Starting capital: **10,000 USDT**
- Commission: 0.1% per side, 1-tick slippage

The backtest is **running now** — results will appear on the card shortly. RSI strategies tend to work best in ranging/choppy markets and can struggle in strong one-directional trends where oversold stays oversold.
